problems: Seam (agent's, confirmed): the patch changes 411 cells of the m2400 anchor, all inside the admin-1 Sumer region: sumerian-city-states 640 -> 232, lagash 3 -> 22, umma 1 -> 11. The m2400-m2301 agent must start from the new anchor.

Root cause left in the dossiers (dossier request): the ledger regions first-dynasty-of-ur/ledger/1, sumerian-city-states/ledger/6, lagash/ledger/2, lagash/ledger/8 and sumerian-city-states/ledger/7 still read 'Sumer minus ...' on the whole admin-1 block. The overrides work only because those gains move the counterpart's cells. lagash/ledger/8 and sumerian-city-states/ledger/7 also include Lagash's own core, which is why events/1 (month 12) is needed. Fix: use the intersection {"intersect":[{"region":"Sumer"},{"cliopatria":"Sumerian City-States","year":-2500}]} in all five, and take Lagash 50 km out of lagash/8 and sumerian-city-states/7; then events/1 can be withdrawn.

Isin (gazetteer place Isin, Al-Qadisiyyah) lies in the admin-1 Sumer region but outside Cliopatria's -2500 outline, so after the patch nobody holds its cell (before, Ur and then Lagash and the collective did). It is a one-cell hole on the plain; left as is.

The Lagash-Umma Gu-edena contest (lagash/ledger/1) shows 0 cells in the m2400 anchor in both the published compile and the trial: sumerian-city-states/ledger/7 takes the contested cell at -2425, and events/1 gives it back to Lagash as direct. The patch did not cause this; the dossier fix above would cure it.
